summary: Ballard Power Systems filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release dated November 5, 2026, announcing that its FCmove-SC fuel cell engine will make its series-production debut in the next-generation Solaris Urbino 12 hydrogen transit bus, following an extension of the companies' long-term supply agreement. The release details product specifications, including up to 80kW rated power, 57% peak efficiency, a 40% part-count reduction and over 25,000 operating hours. No financial terms, stake, price, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. This is an ordinary commercial product and supply announcement, not a special situation; no deal terms to trade around.
